name: [Nyotalia] Steal A Hetalia
desc:
Steal Countries from everyone else! 
Or get your own, and protect them from being stolen.

How to play:
🌎 1. Get countries that appear in the line. 
💸 2. Earn money to get even more characters.
🕵️ 3. Steal from other players.
🔥 4. Rebirth to increase your earnings.
🔧5. Buy gears to troll other users!

⚠️ Small avatars are punishable.

⚠️ Since the game receives updates there will be a few bugs; any bugs should be reported in the Discord!

⚠️ And for any bugs that have directly affected you please make a ticket in the Discord.
